description.sk: Klasika zo Slovenska: mäkké zemiakové halušky obalené v ovčej bryndzi a chrumkavej slanine.
description.en: A Slovak classic: soft potato dumplings tossed in sheep's cheese and crispy bacon.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu aspoň 3 l osolenej vody – halušky potrebujú veľa miesta, aby sa nezlepili. Bryndzu vyber z chladničky, nech sa zohreje na izbovú teplotu a lepšie sa mieša.
steps.en: Bring at least 3 litres of salted water to the boil in a large pan – the dumplings need plenty of room so they do not stick together. Take the bryndza out of the fridge so it warms to room temperature and mixes more easily.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na drobné kocky a opekaj na suchej panvici na strednom ohni asi 8 minút, kým nepustí tuk a nie je chrumkavá. Odstav ju aj s výpekom a drž v teple.
steps.en: Cut the bacon into small dice and fry it in a dry pan over medium heat for about 8 minutes until it releases its fat and turns crisp. Set it aside with the fat and keep warm.

steps.sk: Zemiaky nastrúhaj na jemnom strúhadle do misy a hneď, kým nezhnednú, pridaj vajce, soľ a múku. Vymiešaj husté lepkavé cesto, ktoré pomaly steká z varešky; ak je riedke, pridaj lyžicu-dve múky. Príliš tuhé cesto dá tvrdé halušky.
steps.en: Grate the potatoes finely into a bowl and straight away, before they discolour, add the egg, salt and flour. Mix into a thick, sticky dough that slowly slides off the spoon; if it is runny, add a spoonful or two of flour. Too stiff a dough makes hard dumplings.

steps.sk: Cesto pretláčaj cez haluškár priamo do vriacej vody alebo ho daj na mokrú dosku a nožom namáčaným vo vode odrezávaj do vody tenké kúsky. Vodu medzitým zľahka premiešaj, aby sa halušky neprilepili na dno.
steps.en: Press the dough through a dumpling grater straight into the boiling water, or put it on a wet board and scrape thin pieces into the water with a knife dipped in water. Stir the water gently so the dumplings do not stick to the bottom.

steps.sk: Keď halušky vyplávajú na povrch, var ich ešte 2 minúty. Ochutnaj jednu – má byť pružná a uvarená aj v strede, bez surovej múčnej chuti.
steps.en: Once the dumplings float to the surface, cook them for 2 minutes more. Taste one – it should be springy and cooked through, with no raw floury taste.

steps.sk: Halušky vyber dierovanou naberačkou, nechaj krátko odkvapkať a v teplom hrnci ich hneď zmiešaj s bryndzou a 2 až 3 lyžicami vody z varenia, kým bryndza neobalí všetky halušky. Horúca voda ju rozpustí do krémova.
steps.en: Lift out the dumplings with a slotted spoon, let them drain briefly and immediately mix them in a warm pan with the bryndza and 2 to 3 tablespoons of the cooking water until every dumpling is coated. The hot water melts the cheese into a creamy sauce.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ na taniere, posyp slaninou, polej horúcim výpekom a podľa chuti nasekanou pažítkou. Podávaj hneď, tradične s pohárom kyslého mlieka.
steps.en: Divide between plates, scatter over the bacon, drizzle with the hot fat and sprinkle with chopped chives if you like. Serve at once, traditionally with a glass of soured milk.

title.en: Sauerkraut soup with sausage and mushrooms

description.sk: Hustá, údená a kyslastá polievka, ktorá na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
description.en: A thick, smoky and tangy soup that tastes even better the next day.

steps.sk: Sušené hríby zalej v miske 200 ml horúcej vody a nechaj 15 minút napučať. Potom ich vyber, nahrubo nasekaj a vodu si nechaj – je plná chuti; nalievaj ju opatrne, aby piesok zostal na dne misky.
steps.en: Soak the dried mushrooms in 200 ml of hot water for 15 minutes. Then lift them out and chop them roughly, keeping the water – it is full of flavour; pour it off carefully so any grit stays at the bottom of the bowl.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a pliecko na kocky asi 2 cm. Ak je kapusta veľmi kyslá, krátko ju prepláchni; inak ju len nahrubo nakrájaj, aby nemala dlhé vlákna.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the onion and cut the pork shoulder into roughly 2 cm cubes. If the sauerkraut is very sour, rinse it briefly; otherwise just chop it roughly so there are no long strands.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci rozohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty, kým nezmäkne. Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho asi 6 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zatiahnuté.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add the pork and cook for about 6 minutes until sealed on all sides.

steps.sk: Hrniec stiahni z ohňa, vmiešaj mletú a údenú papriku a rascu (na ohni by paprika zhorkla) a hneď zalej 1,5 l vody. Pridaj kapustu aj so šťavou, bobkové listy, hríby a vodu z hríbov.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat, stir in the paprika, smoked paprika and caraway (over the heat the paprika turns bitter) and immediately pour in 1.5 litres of water. Add the sauerkraut with its juice, the bay leaves, the mushrooms and their soaking water.

steps.sk: Priveď do varu, prikry a mierne var 40 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a ľahko sa rozpadá. Polievka nemá vrieť prudko.
steps.en: Bring to the boil, cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes until the pork is tender and falls apart easily. The soup should not boil hard.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm a klobásu na polkolieska. Pridaj ich do polievky a var ďalších 20 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 1.5 cm cubes; slice the sausage into half-moons. Add them to the soup and simmer for another 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.sk: Múku rozmiešaj v 4 lyžiciach studenej vody do hladka a za stáleho miešania ju vlej do polievky. Osoľ, okoreň a povar ešte 5 minút, kým polievka jemne nezhustne.
steps.en: Whisk the flour with 4 tablespoons of cold water until smooth and pour it into the soup, stirring. Season with the salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes more until slightly thickened.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj – kapustnica má byť kyslo-údená. Podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany a chlebom. Na druhý deň je ešte lepšia; vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke.
steps.en: Taste – kapustnica should be sour and smoky. Serve with a spoonful of sour cream and bread. It is even better the next day and keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer.

title.en: Lentil stew with a fried egg

description.sk: Lacný a sýty prívarok s jemne sladkokyslou chuťou, doplnený vajíčkom.
description.en: A cheap, filling lentil stew with a gentle sweet-sour note, topped with a fried egg.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni v sitku a vyber prípadné kamienky. Daj ju do hrnca, zalej 1 l studenej vody, pridaj bobkové listy a priveď do varu; penu zober lyžicou. Var mierne 25 minút domäkka – zrnká sa majú dať roztlačiť medzi prstami. Soľ pridaj až na konci.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils in a sieve and pick out any small stones. Put them in a pan with 1 litre of cold water and the bay leaves and bring to the boil, skimming off the foam. Simmer gently for 25 minutes until tender – a lentil should crush easily between your fingers. Add the salt only at the end.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno. V malom hrnci zohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút do zlatista. Pridaj múku a za stáleho miešania praž asi 3 minúty, kým zápražka nie je svetlohnedá a nevonia orieškovo – nesmie stmavnúť.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the onion. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a small pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until golden. Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes until the roux is light brown and smells nutty – it must not darken.

steps.sk: Zápražku stiahni z ohňa a rozmiešaj v nej naberačku horúcej tekutiny zo šošovice do hladka – v prívarku potom nebudú hrudky. Potom ju vmiešaj do šošovice.
steps.en: Take the roux off the heat and whisk a ladleful of the hot lentil liquid into it until smooth – this keeps the stew free of lumps. Then stir it into the lentils.

steps.sk: Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán rozotretý medzi prstami, soľ, ocot a cukor a za občasného miešania povar 5 minút, kým prívarok nezhustne. Rád sa pripaľuje, preto miešaj až po dno. Bobkové listy vyber.
steps.en: Add the crushed garlic, the marjoram rubbed between your fingers, the salt, vinegar and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. It catches easily, so stir right down to the bottom. Remove the bay leaves.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji v panvici na strednom ohni usmaž 4 volské oká – asi 3 minúty, kým bielky nie sú stuhnuté a žĺtky tekuté.
steps.en: Fry 4 eggs sunny side up in the remaining oil in a frying pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks runny.

steps.sk: Prívarok ochutnaj – má byť príjemne sladko-kyslý. Podávaj s volským okom a chlebom, prípadne s kyslou uhorkou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni; pri ohrievaní ho zrieď trochou vody, lebo zhustne.
steps.en: Taste the stew – it should be pleasantly sweet and sour. Serve with the fried egg and bread, and a pickled gherkin if you like. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days; thin it with a little water when reheating, as it thickens.

title.sk: Zemiakové placky s cesnakom a majoránom
title.en: Potato pancakes with garlic and marjoram

description.sk: Chrumkavé placky z pár surovín, ktoré má doma takmer každý.
description.en: Crispy pancakes made from a handful of things almost everyone has at home.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a najemno nastrúhaj. Prelož ich do čistej utierky a nad miskou z nich pevne vytlač čo najviac vody – placky budú chrumkavé a nebudú nasávať olej.
steps.en: Peel and finely grate the potatoes. Tip them into a clean tea towel and squeeze out as much liquid as you can over a bowl – the pancakes will be crisp and soak up less oil.

steps.sk: Vodu v miske nechaj 2 minúty postáť, opatrne ju zlej a biely škrob, ktorý sa usadil na dne, vráť k zemiakom – pomôže cestu držať pokope.
steps.en: Let the liquid in the bowl stand for 2 minutes, pour it off carefully and add the white starch that has settled at the bottom back to the potatoes – it helps hold the batter together.

steps.sk: K zemiakom pridaj vajcia, múku, prelisovaný cesnak, majorán rozdrvený medzi prstami, soľ a korenie a dôkladne premiešaj. Cesto priprav až tesne pred smažením, inak zemiaky zhnednú a pustia vodu.
steps.en: Add the eggs, flour, crushed garlic, marjoram crumbled between your fingers, the salt and pepper to the potatoes and mix well. Make the batter just before frying, or the potatoes discolour and turn watery.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na stredne vysokom ohni – olej je dosť horúci, keď kvapka cesta hneď zasyčí. Cesto naberaj lyžicou a roztlač ho na tenké placky s priemerom asi 10 cm; tenšie sú chrumkavejšie.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat – it is hot enough when a drop of batter sizzles at once. Spoon in the batter and flatten it into thin pancakes about 10 cm across; thinner ones are crisper.

steps.sk: Smaž ich 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany do zlatohneda a chrumkava. Olej podľa potreby dolievaj; ak placky rýchlo tmavnú a vnútri sú surové, zníž oheň na stredný.
steps.en: Fry them for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Add more oil as needed; if they darken quickly but are raw inside, lower the heat to medium.

steps.sk: Hotové placky nechaj odkvapkať na papierovej utierke a drž ich v teple v rúre pri 100 °C, kým dopečieš zvyšok. Podávaj teplé, napríklad s kyslou smotanou alebo kyslou kapustou.
steps.en: Drain the finished pancakes on kitchen paper and keep them warm in the oven at 100 °C while you fry the rest. Serve hot, for example with sour cream or sauerkraut.

description.sk: Šťavnaté kuracie stehná v krémovej paprikovej omáčke.
description.en: Juicy chicken thighs in a creamy paprika sauce.

steps.sk: Cibule nakrájaj nadrobno, papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na kúsky a paradajku na kocky. Mäso osuš a nakrájaj na väčšie kusy asi 4 cm.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions, seed the pepper and cut it into pieces, and dice the tomato. Pat the chicken dry and cut it into large pieces of about 4 cm.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu pomaly opekaj asi 8 minút do zlatista; často miešaj. Cibuľa je základ omáčky – čím lepšie je opečená, tým je paprikáš chutnejší.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onions slowly for about 8 minutes until golden, stirring often. The onions are the base of the sauce – the better they are browned, the tastier the paprikash.

steps.sk: Hrniec stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj mletú papriku – nesmie sa pripáliť, inak zhorkne. Hneď pridaj mäso a premiešaj, aby sa obalilo v cibuľovo-paprikovom základe.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the ground paprika – it must not burn or it turns bitter. Add the chicken straight away and stir to coat it in the onion and paprika base.

steps.sk: Hrniec vráť na oheň, pridaj papriku a paradajku, osoľ a podlej 200 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry a na miernom ohni nechaj 25 minút dusiť; občas premiešaj. Mäso je hotové, keď je mäkké a po prepichnutí vyteká číra šťava (vnútri 75 °C).
steps.en: Return the pan to the heat, add the pepper and tomato, season with the salt and pour in 200 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then. The chicken is done when tender and the juices run clear when pierced (75 °C inside).

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar cestoviny v osolenej vode podľa návodu na obale a sceď ich.
steps.en: Meanwhile cook the pasta in salted water according to the packet and drain.

steps.sk: V miske rozmiešaj kyslú smotanu s múkou do hladka a primiešaj 2 lyžice horúcej omáčky – smotana sa potom v hrnci nezrazí. Vmiešaj ju do paprikášu a za stáleho miešania povar 3 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour in a bowl until smooth and stir in 2 tablespoons of the hot sauce – this keeps the cream from splitting in the pan. Stir it into the paprikash and simmer, stirring, for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens.

steps.sk: Podávaj s cestovinami alebo haluškami. Paprikáš vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pri ohrievaní ho už prudko nevar.
steps.en: Serve with the pasta or dumplings. The paprikash keeps in the fridge for 3 days; do not boil it hard when reheating.

title.en: Garlic soup with cheese and croutons

description.sk: Rýchla zahrievacia polievka, ktorá postaví na nohy.
description.en: A quick warming soup that perks you right up.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na malé kocky asi 1 cm. Daj ich do hrnca, zalej 1,2 l vody, pridaj rozdrobený bujón a rascu a priveď do varu. Var 15 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú úplne mäkké.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes of about 1 cm. Put them in a pan with 1.2 litres of water, the crumbled stock cube and the caraway and bring to the boil. Simmer for 15 minutes until completely soft.

steps.sk: Medzitým chlieb nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm a na panvici s olejom ich opekaj na strednom ohni 4 až 5 minút za častého miešania, kým nie sú zlatisté a chrumkavé. Syr nastrúhaj a cesnak ošúp a prelisuj.
steps.en: Meanwhile cut the bread into roughly 1.5 cm cubes and fry them in the oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Grate the cheese and peel and crush the garlic.

steps.sk: Časť zemiakov roztlač varechou o stenu hrnca – polievka trochu zhustne. Pridaj maslo, prelisovaný cesnak a majorán rozotretý medzi prstami a osoľ.
steps.en: Crush some of the potatoes against the side of the pan with a spoon to thicken the soup a little. Add the butter, crushed garlic and the marjoram rubbed between your fingers, and season with the salt.

steps.sk: Polievku už len prehrej, nech nevrie dlhšie ako pol minúty – dlhým varom by cesnak stratil arómu a ostrosť. Ochutnaj; cesnačka má byť výrazne cesnaková.
steps.en: Just heat the soup through and do not let it boil for more than half a minute – long boiling robs the garlic of its aroma and bite. Taste; the soup should be strongly garlicky.

steps.sk: Do tanierov daj strúhaný syr a krutóny a zalej ich horúcou polievkou – syr sa v nej roztopí do vláčikov. Podávaj hneď, kým sú krutóny chrumkavé.
steps.en: Put the grated cheese and croutons into bowls and ladle over the hot soup – the cheese melts into strings. Serve at once while the croutons are crisp.

description.sk: Nadýchané kysnuté lievance na víkendové raňajky.
description.en: Fluffy yeasted pancakes for a weekend breakfast.

steps.sk: Mlieko zohrej len do vlažna – na dotyk má byť príjemne teplé ako telo, nie horúce, inak droždie spáliš. V hrnčeku v ňom rozmiešaj cukor a droždie a nechaj 5 minút postáť, kým sa na povrchu neurobí pena.
steps.en: Warm the milk only until lukewarm – it should feel pleasantly body-warm, not hot, or it kills the yeast. Stir the sugar and yeast into it in a jug and leave for 5 minutes until foamy on top.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj múku so soľou, pridaj vajcia a mlieko s droždím a metličkou alebo vareškou vymiešaj hladké husté cesto bez hrudiek – hustejšie ako na palacinky, pomaly steká z lyžice.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the salt in a bowl, add the eggs and the yeasty milk and beat with a whisk or wooden spoon into a smooth, thick batter without lumps – thicker than for crêpes, slowly dropping off the spoon.

steps.sk: Misu prikry utierkou a nechaj na teplom mieste bez prievanu kysnúť 30 minút, kým cesto nezdvojnásobí objem a nie je plné bubliniek. Po vykysnutí ho už nemiešaj, aby nespľasklo.
steps.en: Cover the bowl with a tea towel and leave in a warm, draught-free place for 30 minutes until the batter has doubled in size and is full of bubbles. Do not stir it after rising or it will collapse.

steps.sk: Panvicu (najlepšie lievanečník) rozohrej na miernom až strednom ohni a jemne ju potri olejom. Lyžicou nalievaj malé kôpky cesta s priemerom asi 8 cm a s medzerami – v panvici ešte nabehnú.
steps.en: Heat a frying pan (ideally a lievance pan with hollows) over medium-low heat and brush it lightly with oil. Spoon in small mounds of batter about 8 cm across with space between them – they spread and rise in the pan.

steps.sk: Peč asi 2 minúty, kým sa na povrchu neurobia bublinky a spodok nie je zlatohnedý. Obráť ich a dopeč ešte minútu. Ak sú zvonku tmavé a vnútri surové, oheň je príliš silný.
steps.en: Cook for about 2 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface and the underside is golden brown. Turn them and cook for another minute. If they are dark outside and raw inside, the heat is too high.

steps.sk: Hotové lievance drž v teple pod utierkou. Podávaj natreté džemom a podľa chuti posypané práškovým cukrom.
steps.en: Keep the finished pancakes warm under a tea towel. Serve spread with the jam and dusted with icing sugar if you like.

title.sk: Kôprová omáčka s vajíčkom a zemiakmi
title.en: Dill sauce with eggs and potatoes

description.sk: Jemná mliečno-kôprová omáčka, aká sa varí u starej mamy.
description.en: A gentle creamy dill sauce like the ones grandmothers make.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na väčšie rovnaké kusy a vlož do hrnca so studenou osolenou vodou. Priveď do varu a var asi 20 minút domäkka, potom ich sceď.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into large even pieces and put them in a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for about 20 minutes until tender, then drain.

steps.sk: Súčasne vajcia vlož do malého hrnca so studenou vodou, priveď do varu a var 9 minút natvrdo. Prelož ich do studenej vody, nechaj vychladnúť a ošúp.
steps.en: At the same time put the eggs in a small pan of cold water, bring to the boil and cook for 9 minutes until hard. Transfer them to cold water, let them cool and peel.

steps.sk: Kôpor umy, osuš a nasekaj nadrobno aj s tenkými stonkami. V hrnci roztop maslo na miernom ohni, pridaj múku a za stáleho miešania ju 1 až 2 minúty praž, kým nezavonia, ale nezmení farbu – omáčka má zostať biela.
steps.en: Wash and dry the dill and chop it finely, thin stalks and all. Melt the butter in a pan over low heat, add the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes until it smells toasty but does not colour – the sauce should stay white.

steps.sk: Po troškách vlievaj studené mlieko a neustále miešaj metličkou, aby nevznikli hrudky. Za stáleho miešania priveď do varu a var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a nestratí múčnu chuť.
steps.en: Pour in the cold milk a little at a time, whisking constantly to prevent lumps. Bring to the boil, still whisking, and simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and loses its floury taste.

steps.sk: Dochuť soľou, cukrom a octom – omáčka má byť jemne sladko-kyslá. Hrniec odstav a kôpor vmiešaj až teraz, varom by stratil farbu aj vôňu. Ak je omáčka hustá, zrieď ju trochou vody.
steps.en: Season with the salt, sugar and vinegar – the sauce should be gently sweet and sour. Take the pan off the heat and only now stir in the dill; boiling dulls its colour and aroma. If the sauce is thick, thin it with a little water.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi a rozpolenými vajíčkami, prelievané omáčkou.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes and halved eggs, with the sauce spooned over.

description.sk: Bravčové mäso dusené s kyslou kapustou a smotanou.
description.en: Pork braised with sauerkraut and sour cream.

steps.sk: Cibule nakrájaj nadrobno a mäso na kocky asi 3 cm. Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj asi 8 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and cut the pork into roughly 3 cm cubes. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onions for about 8 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso, zvýš oheň a opekaj ho asi 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zatiahnuté. Hrniec stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj papriku a rascu – na ohni by paprika zhorkla.
steps.en: Add the pork, turn up the heat and cook for about 5 minutes until sealed on all sides. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway – over the heat the paprika turns bitter.

steps.sk: Podlej 300 ml vody, osoľ, priveď do varu, prikry a na miernom ohni nechaj 40 minút dusiť; občas premiešaj a ak sa tekutina odparí, podlej trochou vody.
steps.en: Pour in 300 ml of water, add the salt, bring to the boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring now and then and adding a little water if it dries out.

steps.sk: Kapustu ochutnaj – ak je veľmi kyslá, prepláchni ju studenou vodou a vytlač. Nahrubo ju nakrájaj, pridaj k mäsu a nechaj prikryté dusiť ďalších 25 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a kapusta zmäkne.
steps.en: Taste the sauerkraut – if it is very sour, rinse it in cold water and squeeze it out. Chop it roughly, add it to the pork and simmer, covered, for another 25 minutes until the meat is tender and the sauerkraut soft.

steps.sk: Medzitým zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na väčšie kusy a var v osolenej vode asi 20 minút domäkka; potom ich sceď.
steps.en: Meanwhile peel the potatoes, cut them into large pieces and cook them in salted water for about 20 minutes until tender; then drain.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s múkou do hladka a primiešaj 2 lyžice horúcej šťavy z gulášu, aby sa smotana nezrazila. Vmiešaj ju do gulášu a za stáleho miešania povar 3 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour until smooth and stir in 2 tablespoons of the hot goulash juices so the cream does not split. Stir it into the goulash and simmer, stirring, for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi, prípadne s knedľou. Guláš je na druhý deň ešte lepší a v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes, or with bread dumplings. The goulash is even better the next day and keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.en: Slovak potato bake with eggs and sausage

description.sk: Zapekané vrstvy zemiakov, vajíčok a klobásy so smotanou.
description.en: Baked layers of potatoes, eggs and sausage with sour cream.

steps.sk: Zemiaky umy a var ich v šupke asi 20 minút, kým nie sú takmer mäkké – nôž má vojsť s miernym odporom, v rúre sa dopečú. Súčasne v inom hrnci var vajcia 9 minút natvrdo.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes and boil them in their skins for about 20 minutes until almost tender – a knife should meet slight resistance; they finish in the oven. At the same time boil the eggs in another pan for 9 minutes until hard.

steps.sk: Zemiaky sceď a vajcia schlaď v studenej vode. Keď trochu vychladnú, všetko ošúp. Vychladnuté zemiaky sa lepšie krájajú – teplé sa rozpadajú.
steps.en: Drain the potatoes and cool the eggs in cold water. Once they have cooled a little, peel everything. Cooled potatoes slice more neatly – warm ones crumble.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Zemiaky a vajcia nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé asi 5 mm, klobásu na tenké plátky a cibuľu nadrobno.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (conventional). Slice the potatoes and eggs about 5 mm thick, slice the sausage thinly and finely chop the onion.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu (asi 30 × 20 cm) vymaž maslom. Vrstvi zemiaky, vajcia, klobásu a cibuľu; každú vrstvu zemiakov osoľ a okoreň. Začni aj skonči zemiakmi – vrchná vrstva sa zapečie dozlatista.
steps.en: Butter a baking dish (about 30 × 20 cm). Layer the potatoes, eggs, sausage and onion, seasoning each layer of potatoes with salt and pepper. Start and finish with potatoes – the top layer bakes golden.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s mliekom do hladka a rovnomerne ňou polej zemiaky; vidličkou nadvihni okraje, aby zatiekla aj medzi vrstvy. Navrch rozlož zvyšok masla na kúsky.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the milk until smooth and pour it evenly over the potatoes, lifting the edges with a fork so it runs between the layers. Dot the rest of the butter over the top.

steps.sk: Peč 35 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatistý a smotana na okrajoch nebublá. Pred krájaním nechaj 5 minút postáť. Podávaj s kyslou uhorkou alebo zeleninovým šalátom; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Bake for 35 minutes until the top is golden and the cream bubbles at the edges. Let it stand for 5 minutes before cutting. Serve with pickled gherkins or a green salad; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Hustá a dymová polievka na chladné dni.
description.en: A thick, smoky soup for cold days.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a klobásu na polkolieska, mrkvu ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska a zemiaky na kocky asi 1,5 cm. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and slice the sausage into half-moons; peel and slice the carrots and cut the potatoes into roughly 1.5 cm cubes. Drain and rinse the beans.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu s klobásou opekaj asi 5 minút, kým cibuľa nezmäkne a klobása nepustí tuk.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion and sausage for about 5 minutes until the onion softens and the sausage releases its fat.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou a za stáleho miešania ju minútu praž. Hrniec stiahni z ohňa, vmiešaj papriku a hneď za stáleho miešania zalej 1,5 l vody, aby nevznikli hrudky.
steps.en: Sprinkle over the flour and cook, stirring, for a minute. Take the pan off the heat, stir in the paprika and immediately pour in 1.5 litres of water, stirring so no lumps form.

steps.sk: Pridaj mrkvu, zemiaky, bobkové listy a soľ, priveď do varu a mierne var 15 minút, kým zelenina nie je takmer mäkká.
steps.en: Add the carrots, potatoes, bay leaves and salt, bring to the boil and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the vegetables are almost tender.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu, prelisovaný cesnak a majorán a var ešte 10 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú úplne mäkké. Bobkové listy vyber.
steps.en: Add the beans, crushed garlic and marjoram and simmer for 10 minutes more until the potatoes are completely soft. Remove the bay leaves.

steps.sk: Dochuť octom – polievka má byť jemne kyslastá. Podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany a chlebom. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke.
steps.en: Season with the vinegar – the soup should be slightly tangy. Serve with a spoonful of sour cream and bread. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer.

description.sk: Lacná, sýta a úplne rastlinná polievka zo špajze.
description.en: A cheap, filling and fully plant-based pantry soup.

steps.sk: Hrach prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra. Daj ho do hrnca, zalej 1,3 l studenej vody, pridaj bobkový list a priveď do varu. Penu z povrchu zober lyžicou, inak by polievka vykypela.
steps.en: Rinse the split peas in a sieve until the water runs clear. Put them in a pan with 1.3 litres of cold water and the bay leaf and bring to the boil. Skim the foam off the top or the soup will boil over.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň a var mierne 40 minút, kým hrach nezmäkne a nezačne sa rozpadávať. Občas premiešaj až po dno, hrach sa rád pripaľuje; ak treba, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Lower the heat and simmer gently for 40 minutes until the peas are soft and starting to break down. Stir right to the bottom now and then, as peas catch easily; add a little water if needed.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a mrkvu a zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky. V panvici zohrej 2 lyžice oleja a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the onion and peel and dice the carrot and potatoes. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Do polievky pridaj cibuľu, zemiaky a mrkvu a var ďalších 15 minút, kým zelenina nie je mäkká.
steps.en: Add the onion, potatoes and carrot to the soup and simmer for another 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.sk: Bobkový list vyber, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a soľ a polievku rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka. Ak je príliš hustá, zrieď ju horúcou vodou – postátím ešte zhustne.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf, add the crushed garlic, marjoram and salt and blend the soup smooth with a stick blender. If it is too thick, thin it with hot water – it thickens further as it stands.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky a na zvyšnom oleji ich opeč dochrumkava. Polievku podávaj posypanú krutónmi. Vydrží 4 dni v chladničke a 3 mesiace v mrazničke (bez krutónov).
steps.en: Cut the bread into cubes and fry them in the remaining oil until crisp. Serve the soup topped with the croutons. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer (without the croutons).

description.sk: Čistý zeleninový vývar s mäsom a rezancami, ktorý pomôže pri prechladnutí.
description.en: A clear vegetable broth with chicken and noodles, a comfort when you have a cold.

steps.sk: Mäso opláchni, daj do veľkého hrnca a zalej 2 l studenej vody – zo studenej vody pustí viac chuti. Pomaly priveď do varu a penu, ktorá sa vytvorí na povrchu, zbieraj lyžicou; vývar tak zostane číry.
steps.en: Rinse the chicken, put it in a large pan and cover with 2 litres of cold water – starting cold draws out more flavour. Bring slowly to the boil, skimming off the foam that forms so the broth stays clear.

steps.sk: Cibuľu neošúpanú rozpoľ a reznou stranou ju opeč na suchej panvici dotmava – vývar dostane zlatú farbu. Pridaj ju do hrnca s novým korením, bobkovým listom a soľou.
steps.en: Halve the unpeeled onion and char the cut sides in a dry frying pan – it gives the broth a golden colour. Add it to the pan with the allspice, bay leaf and salt.

steps.sk: Var mierne – hladina sa má len jemne pohybovať – 40 minút pod pootvorenou pokrievkou. Prudký var vývar zakalí.
steps.en: Simmer very gently – the surface should barely move – for 40 minutes with the lid ajar. A hard boil makes the broth cloudy.

steps.sk: Medzitým mrkvu, petržlen a zeler ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska alebo kocky. Pridaj ich do vývaru a var 15 minút, kým nie sú mäkké, ale nerozvarené.
steps.en: Meanwhile peel the carrots, parsley root and celeriac and cut them into rounds or cubes. Add them to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes until tender but not mushy.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber, nechaj trochu vychladnúť, natrhaj ho na kúsky a vráť do polievky. Cibuľu, nové korenie a bobkový list vyber. Okoreň a ochutnaj.
steps.en: Lift out the chicken, let it cool a little, tear it into pieces and return it to the soup. Remove the onion, allspice and bay leaf. Season with the pepper and taste.

steps.sk: Rezance uvar zvlášť v osolenej vode podľa návodu a sceď – varené v polievke by ju zakalili škrobom. Do tanierov daj rezance, zalej ich horúcou polievkou a posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou. Polievka bez rezancov vydrží v chladničke 4 dni.
steps.en: Cook the noodles separately in salted water according to the packet and drain – cooked in the soup, their starch would cloud it. Put the noodles in bowls, ladle over the hot soup and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Without the noodles the soup keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Orieškovo voňajúca pohánka s opečenými hubami – rastlinná a lacná.
description.en: Nutty buckwheat with fried mushrooms: plant-based and cheap.

steps.sk: Pohánku prepláchni v sitku horúcou vodou a nechaj odkvapkať. V hrnci ju na strednom ohni nasucho praž 2 minúty za stáleho miešania, kým nezavonia orieškovo – zrnká zostanú po uvarení sypké.
steps.en: Rinse the buckwheat in a sieve with hot water and let it drain. Toast it in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until it smells nutty – the grains will stay separate once cooked.

steps.sk: Zalej ju 400 ml horúcej vody s rozpusteným bujónom, priveď do varu, prikry a na miernom ohni var 15 minút, kým nevsiakne všetku vodu. Potom hrniec odstav a nechaj ju 5 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Pour in 400 ml of hot water with the stock cube dissolved in it, bring to the boil, cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes until all the water is absorbed. Then take it off the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým cibule nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska, šampiňóny na plátky a cesnak nasekaj. Vo veľkej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Meanwhile slice the onions into thin half-moons, slice the mushrooms and chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Pridaj huby a rascu, zvýš oheň a opekaj 8 minút za občasného miešania. Huby najprv pustia vodu – nechaj ju úplne odpariť, až potom sa začnú opekať a zlatnúť.
steps.en: Add the mushrooms and caraway, turn up the heat and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then. The mushrooms release water first – let it evaporate completely; only then do they brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak a korenie, minútu miešaj a potom všetko zmiešaj s pohánkou. Ochutnaj – bujón je slaný, ďalšiu soľ zvyčajne netreba. Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj, napríklad s kyslou uhorkou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the garlic and pepper, stir for a minute and then mix everything with the buckwheat. Taste – the stock is salty, so it usually needs no more salt. Sprinkle with parsley and serve, for example with a pickled gherkin. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Vianočná klasika z krúp a sušených húb s cesnakom a majoránom.
description.en: A Christmas classic of pearl barley, dried mushrooms, garlic and marjoram.

steps.sk: Sušené hríby zalej v miske 300 ml horúcej vody a nechaj 20 minút namočené. Krúpy prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a var ich vo väčšom množstve osolenej vody 25 minút domäkka – majú byť mäkké, ale stále mierne pružné. Sceď ich.
steps.en: Soak the dried mushrooms in 300 ml of hot water for 20 minutes. Rinse the pearl barley in a sieve until the water runs clear and cook it in plenty of salted water for 25 minutes until tender but still slightly chewy. Drain.

steps.sk: Hríby vyber z vody a nahrubo nasekaj. Vodu preceď cez sitko alebo papierovú utierku – na dne býva piesok. Rúru predhrej na 180 °C (horný a spodný ohrev).
steps.en: Lift the mushrooms out of the water and chop them roughly. Strain the water through a sieve or kitchen paper – there is often grit at the bottom. Preheat the oven to 180 °C (conventional).

steps.sk: Cibule nakrájaj nadrobno. V panvici zohrej 3 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút do zlatista. Pridaj hríby aj s precedenou vodou a nechaj 10 minút dusiť, kým sa väčšina vody neodparí.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions. Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes until golden. Add the mushrooms with the strained water and simmer for 10 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj krúpy s hríbovou zmesou, prelisovaným cesnakom, majoránom rozotretým medzi prstami, rascou, soľou a korením. Ochutnaj – kuba má byť výrazne cesnaková a majoránová.
steps.en: Mix the barley with the mushroom mixture, crushed garlic, the marjoram rubbed between your fingers, the caraway, salt and pepper in a bowl. Taste – kuba should be distinctly garlicky and full of marjoram.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu vymasti zvyšným olejom, kubu do nej prelož, zarovnaj a zľahka pritlač. Peč odkrytú 25 minút, kým povrch nezačne chrumkať a zlatnúť.
steps.en: Grease a baking dish with the remaining oil, spoon in the kuba, level it and press it down lightly. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes until the top starts to crisp and turn golden.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplú, napríklad s kyslou uhorkou alebo kyslou kapustou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a ohriata na panvici je ešte chrumkavejšia.
steps.en: Serve warm, for example with pickled gherkins or sauerkraut. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and is even crisper reheated in a frying pan.

description.sk: Papriky plnené mäsom a ryžou v sladkokyslej paradajkovej omáčke.
description.en: Peppers stuffed with meat and rice in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var ju vo vriacej vode 8 minút, aby bola napoly mäkká – v paprike sa dovarí. Sceď ju a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it in boiling water for 8 minutes until half done – it finishes cooking inside the peppers. Drain and let it cool.

steps.sk: Paprikám odrež vrchnáky, vyber jadrovníky so semienkami a vnútro prepláchni. Cibuľu nastrúhaj najemno a cesnak prelisuj.
steps.en: Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the cores and seeds and rinse the insides. Finely grate the onion and crush the garlic.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj mäso s ryžou, vajcom, cibuľou, cesnakom, mletou paprikou, 1 lyžičkou soli a korením a rukami dôkladne premiešaj, kým sa plnka nespojí. Papriky ňou naplň voľne, nie natesno – ryža ešte napučí a papriku by roztrhla.
steps.en: Mix the pork with the rice, egg, onion, garlic, ground paprika, 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper in a bowl and work it with your hands until it holds together. Fill the peppers loosely, not tightly – the rice swells and would split them.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci, do ktorého sa papriky zmestia nastojato, zmiešaj passatu s 300 ml vody, cukrom a zvyšnou soľou a priveď do varu. Papriky do omáčky vlož otvorom nahor; zvyšnú plnku vytvaruj na guľky a pridaj k nim.
steps.en: In a wide pan that holds the peppers upright, mix the passata with 300 ml of water, the sugar and the remaining salt and bring to the boil. Stand the peppers in the sauce, open side up; shape any leftover filling into balls and add them too.

steps.sk: Prikry a var na miernom ohni 45 minút; občas hrncom jemne zakrúž, aby sa omáčka nepripálila. Plnka je hotová, keď je v strede prepečená, bez ružovej farby (75 °C).
steps.en: Cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes, gently swirling the pan now and then so the sauce does not catch. The filling is done when cooked through in the centre with no pink (75 °C).

steps.sk: Múku rozmiešaj v 4 lyžiciach studenej vody do hladka a vmiešaj do omáčky okolo paprík. Povar 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a nestratí múčnu chuť. Ochutnaj – má byť sladko-kyslá.
steps.en: Mix the flour with 4 tablespoons of cold water until smooth and stir it into the sauce around the peppers. Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and loses its floury taste. Taste – it should be sweet and sour.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ošúpané zemiaky v osolenej vode. Podávaj papriky so zemiakmi alebo knedľou, bohato prelievané omáčkou. Vydržia 3 dni v chladničke a dajú sa zamraziť aj s omáčkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile boil the peeled potatoes in salted water. Serve the peppers with the potatoes or bread dumplings and plenty of sauce. They keep for 3 days in the fridge and freeze well in their sauce.

title.sk: Kuracie prsia na prírodno s ryžou a hráškom
title.en: Pan-roasted chicken breast with rice and peas

description.sk: Jednoduché ľahké jedlo s množstvom bielkovín – klasika školských jedální, ale šťavnatá.
description.en: A simple, light, protein-rich meal: a school canteen classic, only juicy.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku a v hrnci ju zalej 210 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry a na najmenšom ohni var 12 minút; posledné 3 minúty na ňu nasyp hrášok a znova prikry. Potom nechaj 5 minút postáť.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve and put it in a pan with 210 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover and cook over the lowest heat for 12 minutes; scatter the peas over it for the last 3 minutes and cover again. Then let it stand for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Prsia osuš a pozdĺžne ich rozkroj na dva tenšie plátky, aby sa upiekli rýchlo a rovnomerne. Z oboch strán ich osoľ a okoreň a jednu stranu poprás múkou – vytvorí kôrku a neskôr zahustí šťavu.
steps.en: Pat the chicken breasts dry and slice them horizontally into two thinner fillets so they cook quickly and evenly. Season both sides with the salt and pepper and dust one side with the flour – it forms a crust and later thickens the juices.

steps.sk: V panvici roztop maslo na stredne vysokom ohni, kým sa nespení. Plátky polož múkou nadol a opekaj 4 minúty bez hýbania, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Potom ich obráť a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat until it foams. Lay in the fillets floured side down and cook for 4 minutes without moving them until golden brown. Then turn them and cook for 3 minutes more.

steps.sk: Bujón rozpusti v 150 ml horúcej vody a podlej ním mäso. Varechou vyškrab opečené zvyšky z dna a povar 3 minúty, kým šťava nezhustne a mäso nie je vnútri biele (74 °C).
steps.en: Dissolve the stock cube in 150 ml of hot water and pour it over the chicken. Scrape up the browned bits from the bottom with a wooden spoon and simmer for 3 minutes until the juices thicken and the chicken is white inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Mäso prelož na taniere k ryži s hráškom, prelej šťavou z panvice a posyp petržlenovou vňaťou. Na meal prep ho ulož do krabičiek aj so šťavou, aby nevyschlo; vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Put the chicken on plates with the rice and peas, pour over the pan juices and sprinkle with parsley. For meal prep, pack it with the juices so it does not dry out; it keeps for 3 days.

description.sk: Lacný a jemný prívarok, ktorý chutí ako u starej mamy.
description.en: A cheap, gentle stew that tastes like a grandmother's.

steps.sk: Z kelu odstráň vonkajšie poškodené listy a hrubý hlúb. Listy nakrájaj na rezance široké asi 1 cm a umy ich. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm.
steps.en: Remove any damaged outer leaves and the thick core from the savoy cabbage. Cut the leaves into strips about 1 cm wide and wash them. Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 1.5 cm cubes.

steps.sk: Kel so zemiakmi daj do hrnca, zalej 800 ml vody, pridaj soľ a rascu a priveď do varu. Var 15 minút, kým kel aj zemiaky nie sú mäkké. Vodu nevylievaj – je základom prívarku.
steps.en: Put the cabbage and potatoes in a pan with 800 ml of water, the salt and caraway and bring to the boil. Simmer for 15 minutes until both are tender. Do not drain – the liquid is the base of the stew.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav zápražku: v malom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni, vsyp múku a za stáleho miešania ju praž 2 minúty, kým nie je svetlá a nevonia. Stiahni z ohňa a postupne vmiešaj studené mlieko do hladka.
steps.en: Meanwhile make the roux: heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat, add the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes until pale and fragrant. Take it off the heat and gradually whisk in the cold milk until smooth.

steps.sk: Zápražku vmiešaj do kelu, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a korenie a za stáleho miešania povar 5 minút, kým prívarok nezhustne. Miešaj až po dno, aby sa nepripálil. Časť zemiakov môžeš roztlačiť, prívarok bude krémovejší.
steps.en: Stir the roux into the cabbage, add the crushed garlic, marjoram and pepper and simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes until thick. Stir right to the bottom so it does not catch. Crush some of the potatoes for a creamier stew if you like.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj a podávaj samotný s chlebom alebo s volským okom (usmaž ho na kvapke oleja asi 3 minúty, kým bielok nestuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý). Prívarok vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Taste and serve on its own with bread or with a fried egg (fry it in a drop of oil for about 3 minutes until the white is set and the yolk still runny). The stew keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Strapačky s kyslou kapustou a slaninou
title.en: Potato dumplings with sauerkraut and bacon

description.sk: Sestra bryndzových halušiek – s dusenou kyslou kapustou.
description.en: The sister of bryndza dumplings, with braised sauerkraut.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu aspoň 3 l osolenej vody na halušky. Slaninu nakrájaj na drobné kocky a cibuľu nadrobno. Kapustu ochutnaj – ak je veľmi kyslá, prepláchni ju a vytlač; potom ju nahrubo nakrájaj.
steps.en: Bring at least 3 litres of salted water to the boil in a large pan for the dumplings. Dice the bacon and finely chop the onion. Taste the sauerkraut – if it is very sour, rinse and squeeze it; then chop it roughly.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej panvici alebo širokom hrnci opekaj slaninu na strednom ohni bez oleja asi 5 minút, kým nepustí tuk a nezačne chrumkať. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj ju vo výpeku ďalšie 4 minúty do zlatista.
steps.en: Fry the bacon in a large frying pan or wide pan over medium heat without oil for about 5 minutes until it releases its fat and starts to crisp. Add the onion and cook it in the fat for another 4 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Pridaj kapustu, rascu, korenie a 100 ml vody, premiešaj, prikry a na miernom ohni nechaj 20 minút dusiť, kým kapusta nezmäkne. Občas premiešaj; na konci nechaj zvyšnú tekutinu odpariť.
steps.en: Add the sauerkraut, caraway, pepper and 100 ml of water, stir, cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes until soft. Stir now and then; at the end let any remaining liquid evaporate.

steps.sk: Medzitým zemiaky ošúp a najemno nastrúhaj. Hneď ich zmiešaj s vajcom, soľou a múkou na husté lepkavé cesto, ktoré pomaly steká z lyžice; ak je riedke, pridaj trochu múky.
steps.en: Meanwhile peel and finely grate the potatoes. Immediately mix them with the egg, salt and flour into a thick, sticky dough that slowly drops off the spoon; if it is runny, add a little flour.

steps.sk: Cesto pretláčaj cez haluškár alebo ho z mokrej dosky odrezávaj nožom do vriacej vody. Keď halušky vyplávajú na povrch, var ich ešte 2 minúty, potom ich vyber dierovanou naberačkou a nechaj odkvapkať.
steps.en: Press the dough through a dumpling grater, or scrape it off a wet board with a knife, into the boiling water. Once the dumplings float, cook them for 2 minutes more, then lift them out with a slotted spoon and let them drain.

steps.sk: Halušky vmiešaj do kapusty so slaninou a ešte 2 minúty ich spolu na ohni premiešavaj, aby nasali chuť a jemne sa opiekli. Podávaj hneď, podľa chuti s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Stir the dumplings into the sauerkraut and bacon and toss everything over the heat for 2 minutes so they take on the flavour and toast lightly. Serve at once, with sour cream if you like.

description.sk: Zemiakové knedle plnené slivkami, obalené v maslovej strúhanke.
description.en: Potato dumplings filled with plums and rolled in buttery breadcrumbs.

note.en: boiled in their skins and cooled

steps.sk: Zemiaky umy, v šupke ich zalej studenou vodou a var asi 25 minút domäkka. Sceď ich, ošúp a nechaj úplne vychladnúť – teplé zemiaky nasajú priveľa múky a knedle sú tuhé. Najlepšie je uvariť ich deň vopred.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes, cover them in their skins with cold water and boil for about 25 minutes until tender. Drain, peel and let them cool completely – warm potatoes absorb too much flour and make heavy dumplings. Ideally cook them the day before.

steps.sk: Vychladnuté zemiaky najemno nastrúhaj na dosku. Pridaj múku, vajce a soľ a rýchlo vypracuj vláčne cesto, ktoré sa nelepí na ruky. Dlho ho nemies – zmäklo by a lepilo sa; ak sa lepí, pridaj trochu múky.
steps.en: Finely grate the cold potatoes onto a board. Add the flour, egg and salt and quickly work into a soft dough that does not stick to your hands. Do not knead it for long – it softens and turns sticky; if it sticks, add a little flour.

steps.sk: Slivky umy, osuš, z boku ich nakroj a vyber kôstky. Cukor zmiešaj so škoricou a do každej slivky nasyp štipku zmesi. Medzitým priveď do varu veľký hrniec osolenej vody.
steps.en: Wash and dry the plums, slit them along one side and remove the stones. Mix the sugar with the cinnamon and put a pinch inside each plum. Meanwhile bring a large pan of salted water to the boil.

steps.sk: Cesto vyvaľkaj do valčeka a rozdeľ na 12 rovnakých kúskov. Každý roztlač v dlani na placku hrubú asi 5 mm, polož naň slivku, cesto okolo nej pritiahni, uzavri a v dlaniach vytvaruj hladkú guľu bez prasklín – inak by do knedle vnikla voda.
steps.en: Roll the dough into a log and divide it into 12 equal pieces. Flatten each in your palm into a disc about 5 mm thick, put a plum in the middle, draw the dough up around it, seal it and roll it between your palms into a smooth ball with no cracks – otherwise water gets in.

steps.sk: Knedle vkladaj do vriacej vody po menších dávkach, zľahka premiešaj, aby sa neprilepili na dno, a zníž oheň na mierny var. Od vyplávania ich var 8 až 10 minút; hotová knedľa je pevná a slivka v nej mäkká.
steps.en: Lower the dumplings into the boiling water in small batches, stir gently so they do not stick to the bottom and reduce to a gentle simmer. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes after they float; a cooked dumpling is firm and the plum inside is soft.

steps.sk: Medzitým v panvici roztop maslo, pridaj strúhanku a za stáleho miešania ju na miernom ohni praž 3 až 4 minúty dozlatista – rýchlo sa pripáli. Uvarené knedle vyber dierovanou naberačkou, nechaj odkvapkať a obaľ ich v masle so strúhankou.
steps.en: Meanwhile melt the butter in a frying pan, add the breadcrumbs and toast them over low heat, stirring constantly, for 3 to 4 minutes until golden – they burn quickly. Lift the cooked dumplings out with a slotted spoon, let them drain and roll them in the buttery crumbs.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplé, posypané práškovým cukrom. Pozor, slivka vo vnútri je veľmi horúca.
steps.en: Serve warm, dusted with icing sugar. Careful – the plum inside is very hot.

description.sk: Chrumkavý rezeň opečený na panvici – najlepší so zemiakovým šalátom.
description.en: A crisp pan-fried schnitzel, best with potato salad.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia osuš a vodorovne ich rozkroj na tenšie plátky. Prikry ich potravinovou fóliou a paličkou na mäso alebo dnom hrnca ich jemne naklep na hrúbku asi 1 cm. Rovnako hrubé plátky sa vyprážajú rovnomerne.
steps.en: Pat the chicken breasts dry and slice them horizontally into thinner escalopes. Cover them with cling film and pound them gently with a meat mallet or the bottom of a pan to about 1 cm thick. Escalopes of even thickness fry evenly.

steps.sk: Plátky z oboch strán osoľ. Priprav si tri plytké misky: v prvej múku, v druhej vajcia rozšľahané vidličkou s 2 lyžicami vody a v tretej strúhanku.
steps.en: Season the escalopes with the salt on both sides. Set out three shallow dishes: flour in the first, the eggs beaten with a fork and 2 tablespoons of water in the second, and the breadcrumbs in the third.

steps.sk: Každý rezeň obaľ v múke a otrep prebytok, ponor do vajca, nechaj odkvapkať a nakoniec ho obaľ v strúhanke, ktorú len zľahka pritlač. Obalené rezne hneď vyprážaj, inak obal zvlhne.
steps.en: Coat each escalope in flour and shake off the excess, dip it in the egg, let it drip and finally coat it in the breadcrumbs, pressing them on only lightly. Fry the coated escalopes straight away or the coating turns damp.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni tak, aby pokrýval dno asi do výšky 5 mm. Je dosť horúci, keď sa okolo hodenej omrvinky strúhanky hneď vytvoria bublinky.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat so it covers the bottom about 5 mm deep. It is hot enough when a crumb dropped in sizzles immediately.

steps.sk: Rezne vyprážaj po dvoch 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Mäso je hotové, keď je vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby (74 °C). Ak obal tmavne príliš rýchlo, zníž oheň.
steps.en: Fry the escalopes two at a time for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden brown. The chicken is done when white inside with no pink (74 °C). If the coating darkens too quickly, lower the heat.

steps.sk: Hotové rezne nechaj odkvapkať na papierovej utierke alebo mriežke a drž ich v teple v rúre pri 100 °C, kým dovyprážaš zvyšok. Podávaj s mesiačikmi citróna, napríklad so zemiakovým šalátom alebo zemiakmi.
steps.en: Drain the finished escalopes on kitchen paper or a rack and keep them warm in the oven at 100 °C while you fry the rest. Serve with lemon wedges, for example with potato salad or boiled potatoes.

description.sk: Vianočný zemiakový šalát so zeleninou, uhorkami a jogurtovo-majonézovým dresingom.
description.en: The Christmas potato salad with vegetables, pickles and a yogurt-mayonnaise dressing.

steps.sk: Zemiaky (najlepšie pevné, šalátové) umy a v šupke ich var 25 minút domäkka. V inom hrnci var neošúpanú mrkvu a petržlen 15 minút a v malom hrnci vajcia 9 minút natvrdo.
steps.en: Scrub the potatoes (ideally a waxy salad variety) and boil them in their skins for 25 minutes until tender. In another pan cook the unpeeled carrots and parsley root for 15 minutes, and in a small pan boil the eggs for 9 minutes until hard.

steps.sk: Všetko sceď a nechaj vychladnúť – zemiaky aspoň do vlažna, inak sa pri krájaní rozpadajú a šalát je kašovitý. Rozložené na plechu vychladnú rýchlejšie. Vajcia schlaď v studenej vode.
steps.en: Drain everything and let it cool – the potatoes at least to lukewarm, or they crumble when cut and the salad turns mushy. Spread on a tray, they cool faster. Cool the eggs in cold water.

steps.sk: Zemiaky, mrkvu, petržlen a vajcia ošúp a nakrájaj na drobné kocky asi 1 cm, rovnako ako uhorky a cibuľu. Hrášok zalej na 2 minúty vriacou vodou a sceď.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, carrots, parsley root and eggs and cut them into small dice of about 1 cm, along with the gherkins and onion. Cover the peas with boiling water for 2 minutes and drain.

steps.sk: Dresing: v mise zmiešaj majonézu s jogurtom, horčicou, soľou, korením a 2 až 3 lyžicami nálevu z uhoriek – jogurt šalát odľahčí a nálev mu dodá sviežu kyslosť.
steps.en: Dressing: mix the mayonnaise with the yoghurt, mustard, salt, pepper and 2 to 3 tablespoons of the gherkin brine in a large bowl – the yoghurt lightens the salad and the brine adds a fresh tang.

steps.sk: Zeleninu, vajcia a hrášok zmiešaj s dresingom a opatrne premiešaj, aby sa zemiaky nerozpučili. Ochutnaj a podľa chuti dochuť nálevom z uhoriek.
steps.en: Fold the vegetables, eggs and peas into the dressing gently so the potatoes do not break up. Taste and add more gherkin brine if you like.

steps.sk: Šalát môžeš podávať hneď, ale po 2 hodinách v chladničke sa chute spoja a je lepší. V uzavretej nádobe vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pred podávaním ho premiešaj.
steps.en: You can serve the salad straight away, but after 2 hours in the fridge the flavours meld and it tastes better. In a closed container it keeps in the fridge for 3 days; stir before serving.
